scope: All Stage 18 READY_VERIFIED exact lesson SkillContracts routed through the Mathematics V2 production renderer.
policy: For migrated exact games the server owns problem generation, solver verification and answer correctness. The browser owns rendering and interaction only and never receives the authoritative answer.

legacyCompatibility.scope: Non-migrated or rollout-disabled game routes may retain legacy browser interaction, but they are not Stage 22 server-verified mathematics and do not become authoritative mastery evidence.
legacyCompatibility.exactRolloutFallback: An enabled Mathematics V2 exact route must never silently fall back to browser grading when server verification is unavailable.
